title: QSplit Quantum Connector Wrapper
description: Connector wrapper that selects a quantum provider at runtime and forwards commands to the wrapped connector.

provider.description: Fallback provider used when auto-selection cannot pick an active backend.

providerPool.description: List (or comma-separated string) of providers considered by auto-selection.

providerServiceMap.description: Optional mapping provider -> service name, used to route providers to different SLURM services.

providerServiceFallbackMap.description: Optional mapping provider -> fallback service list (or comma-separated string), used when a submission is cancelled by the scheduler.

maxConcurrentJobs.description: Optional mapping provider -> max concurrent jobs. Overrides maxProviderJobs for the given provider.

maxProviderJobs.description: If set, limit concurrent jobs per provider (best-effort, within the current StreamFlow process).

providerConfigMap.description: Supervisor-only provider YAML paths, relative to the StreamFlow config directory. Worker files must be supplied through CWL inputs.

providerPythonMap.description: Explicit Python executable per provider for scatter and isolated metrics probes.
